description: Find the drum named on the amber malt batch card in a maltings drying folder. DISTILL-CANARY-d68ff654

files.README.md:
Cobbshill Maltings - batch cards

One card is written for every drying run and filed here until the malt is
weighed out to the brewery. The card is filled in at the kiln as the batch goes
in, so the drum and the load are both on the first line.

turns.prompt: Cobbshill Maltings runs one batch of malt through a drum at a time. The card written for the amber malt batch names the drum that batch went into. Which drum is that? Report the drum number.
